n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

MAXN = (1 << 19) | 5
maxn = 0
popcount_vals = [0] * MAXN
f_vals = [0] * MAXN
tmp1_data = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(20)]
tmp2_data = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(20)]
tmp3_data = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(20)]
trans_data = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(20)]
fact_arr = [0] * MAXN
inv_fact_arr = [0] * MAXN

total_pow = 0

def pow_mod(base, exp):
    res = 1
    cur = base
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * cur % p
        cur = cur * cur % p
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def setup():
    fact_arr[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, maxn + 1):
        fact_arr[i] = fact_arr[i - 1] * i % p
    inv_fact_arr[maxn] = pow_mod(fact_arr[maxn], p - 2)
    for i in range(maxn - 1, -1, -1):
        inv_fact_arr[i] = inv_fact_arr[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p

def get_lower_power(x):
    res = 1
    while res < x:
        res <<= 1
    return res

def FWT_transform(arr, length, inv=False):
    temp = arr[:]
    step = 1
    while step < length:
        for j in range(0, length, step << 1):
            for k in range(j, j + step):
                val = temp[k]
                if inv:
                    temp[k + step] -= val
                else:
                    temp[k + step] += val
        step <<= 1
    for i in range(length):
        arr[i] = temp[i] % p

def mod_adjust(x):
    if x >= total_pow:
        x -= total_pow

def perform_multiply():
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        for q in range(20):
            tmp1_data[q][i] = 0
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        for q in range(20):
            tmp1_data[q][i] = 0
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        popcount_vals[i] = bin(i).count('1')
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        tmp1_data[popcount_vals[i]][i] = f_vals[i]
    for q in range(20):
        FWT_transform(tmp1_data[q], maxn + 1)
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q):
            for s in range(maxn + 1):
                trans_data[q + l][s] += tmp1_data[q][s] * tmp2_data[l][s]
                trans_data[q + l][s] %= p
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxn + 1):
            tmp3_data[q][s] = trans_data[q][s]
    for q in range(20):
        FWT_transform(tmp3_data[q], maxn + 1, inv=True)
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        f_vals[i] = tmp3_data[popcount_vals[i]][i]

def perform_alt_multiply():
    temp = [[0] * (maxn + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(maxn + 1):
            trans_data[i][s] = 0
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q):
            for s in range(maxn + 1):
                trans_data[q + l][s] += tmp2_data[q][s] * tmp2_data[l][s]
                trans_data[q + l][s] %= p
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxn + 1):
            temp[q][s] = trans_data[q][s]
    for q in range(20):
        FWT_transform(temp[q], maxn + 1, inv=True)
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(maxn + 1):
            tmp2_data[i][s] = 0
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        popcount_vals[i] = bin(i).count('1')
        tmp2_data[popcount_vals[i]][i] = temp[popcount_vals[i]][i]
    for i in range(20):
        FWT_transform(tmp2_data[i], maxn + 1)

if n & 1:
    print(pow_mod(k, n))
    exit()

f_vals[0] = 1
maxn = get_lower_power(n + 1) - 1
setup()

for i in range(maxn + 1):
    popcount_vals[i] = bin(i).count('1')

for i in range(maxn + 1):
    tmp2_data[popcount_vals[i]][i] = inv_fact_arr[i]

for i in range(20):
    FWT_transform(tmp2_data[i], maxn + 1)

res_k = k
while res_k:
    if res_k & 1:
        perform_multiply()
    res_k >>= 1
    if res_k:
        perform_alt_multiply()

result = (pow_mod(k, n) - fact_arr[n] * f_vals[n] % p + p) % p
print(result)
